title: Navigation and Project Visibility Epic
description:
Improve navigation and project visibility by making relationships, hierarchies, and dependencies visible in the primary interface. 

Core insight: Pebbles has rich relationship data (part_of, required_for, scheduled_before) but displays issues as flat lists. This epic addresses the gap between structured data and flat display.

Goals:
- Show hierarchical structure (epics and their children)
- Display dependency status (blocked, ready, blocking)
- Provide context without extra commands (show titles in relationships)
- Enable quick project overview (summary command)
- Help users discover and organize issues (filters, counts, indicators)

Success: Users can navigate projects by understanding relationships visually, not just through data queries.
